description: provenanceType assigned to each of the 21 currently registered rules, determined by inspecting what actually justifies each rule's condition (a real formula/geometric necessity vs. a chosen-for-prototype-safety threshold). No rule is assigned professional_review, manufacturer_specification, or regulatory_or_standards_body, because none currently has that provenance — assigning one would violate FORGE-GOV-003.

vectors.notes: The size<->diameter formula (EU/French convention, size = pi*diameter - 40) is a real, named sizing convention; the 0.15mm/0.5mm discrepancy thresholds that decide when to flag it are separately a prototype_heuristic choice.
A stone's depth exceeding its own diameter is geometrically implausible for the lofted round-brilliant approximation used here, independent of any specific numeric threshold.
The {4,6} set reflects what the current prong geometry builder supports, not a jewelry-industry standard prong count.
If prongs do not rise above the basket, the current geometry builder cannot produce a coherent stone-holding structure.
A zero or negative basket height cannot be constructed into a real solid by the current builder.
The band builder requires a positive outer-minus-inner dimension and a positive width to construct any solid at all.
